info.title: Discordy internal API
info.description: Service-to-service HTTP APIs (`/internal/v1`). Every call carries `X-Internal-Token: $INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN`. Tags name the owning service. `GET /admin/stats` exists on api, messages and gateway with the shapes ApiAdminStats, MessagesAdminStats and GatewayAdminStats respectively.

post.summary: Acquire or renew a committed Snowflake interval for one messages process

200.description: Committed interval. Timestamp and monotonic deadline checks are mandatory.

400.description: Invalid service, owner, worker or request shape.

503.description: Capacity exhausted, expired ownership, clock rollback, restore barrier or unavailable database. No new interval was granted.

post.summary: Validate a user or bot token

get.summary: Read-state snapshots for gateway identification and resume

200.description: Array retained for legacy compatibility. Certified responses require a version on every entry. Snapshot reads are per channel, not one cross-channel transaction.

X-Read-State-Versioned.description: Value 1 certifies authoritative versioned accounting even for an empty array. Absent means legacy; malformed certification must not become an empty successful snapshot.

503.description: Read-state dependency unavailable; gateway must not certify an empty state.

get.summary: Full guild state for the gateway guild process
Permissions and effective delivery mode of a user in a channel
get.description: Resolves current account eligibility as well as membership and channel permissions. Missing, disabled, pending-deletion or currently suspended users receive 403. Expired suspensions and eligible bots retain ordinary channel access. No user session/token is required by this internal lookup; an offline scheduled author can remain eligible. Consumers needing fresh dispatch authorization must bypass cached and already in-flight lookups. This check and a later message write are not one cross-service transaction.

get.summary: Page permitted recipients and resolved preferences independently of push tokens
get.description: For messages mention accounting. Includes users without a mobile push token, excludes the author and users without VIEW_CHANNEL, and returns an empty terminal page for private delivery modes. limit bounds candidates examined, so a page filtered by permissions can be empty while next_after is non-null. Follow next_after until null; it strictly advances by candidate user ID. Policy is current per request, not a historical or cross-page snapshot. The consumer still applies message kind, mentions, silent/reply flags and idempotent read-state accounting.

parameters.name: author_id
parameters.description: Message author to exclude, including a webhook author ID. Decimal ID in 0..9223372036854775807.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Continue strictly after this candidate user ID. Decimal ID in 0..9223372036854775807; values outside the database range are rejected rather than wrapped.

200.description: Current permitted recipients; empty pages can still have a continuation.

400.description: Invalid author, continuation or page size.

500.description: Recipient or preference lookup failed; no fallback to unfiltered users.

get.summary: Service statistics (api, messages and gateway each answer with their own shape)

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return users with a higher ID.

post.summary: Post a bot, webhook, interaction or system message (messages service)

400.description: Invalid body, for example type 18 without thread_id.

409.description: The channel is not in standard delivery mode (code 50160).

patch.summary: Record the end of a call on its system message (messages service)

400.description: Not a call message or invalid timestamp.

get.summary: Last message ID of a channel (messages service)

post.summary: Record an idempotent gateway voice activity observation
post.description: Observations are scoped by guild, user, session and gateway generation. Only consecutive observations at most 60 seconds apart contribute; coverage remains incomplete.

get.summary: Count observed guild message markers for a UTC day (messages)
get.description: Counts are provisional until producer coverage has been established after rollout. utc_day is days since the Unix epoch.

get.summary: Check a member's current voice channel in the owning gateway guild process

503.description: The owning process could not be queried.

post.summary: Stop allocating to a voice node (gateway)
Resume allocating to a voice node (gateway)

Forbidden.description: The user is not a member of the channel.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: A user activity as stored and fanned out. The gateway sanitises client activities (PRESENCE_UPDATE): only the fields below are kept, unknown fields (including `application_id`) are dropped, and a violation closes the socket with 4002.

type.description: ActivityType, 0..5. At most one activity per presence may be type 4 (custom status).

AdminGuild.title: AdminGuild
AdminGuild.description: A guild as listed in the admin portal.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: A user as listed in the admin portal.

AdminUserPage.title: AdminUserPage
AdminUserPage.description: GET /internal/v1/admin/users: a page of users, ordered by ID.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page; null at the end.

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: A file attached to a message.

flags.description: AttachmentFlags bit set; IS_SPOILER (8) marks a spoiler. When present, flags are authoritative: 0 clears a spoiler even for a SPOILER_ filename. Infer the filename prefix only when flags are absent.

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: A guild channel, DM, group DM or thread. `delivery_mode` and `voice_region` are Discordy extras.

status.description: Voice-channel status text, or null when unset.

text_chat_enabled.description: Voice channels only: whether members can send messages to the channel chat. Defaults to true.

delivery_mode.description: Discordy: effective delivery mode. Always present on full channel objects.

voice_region.description: Discordy: per-channel voice region override; null uses the guild's voice_region.

ChannelAccess.title: ChannelAccess
ChannelAccess.description: GET /internal/v1/channels/{channel_id}/access/{user_id}. Current account eligibility is required: missing, disabled, pending-deletion or currently suspended users receive 403. Eligible bots and expired suspensions keep existing membership/permission behavior. No user session is required; fresh scheduled dispatch checks bypass caches and older in-flight requests. The response shape is unchanged, and the check/write race remains cross-service.

ChannelMention.title: ChannelMention
ChannelMention.description: A channel mentioned in a message.

message_notifications.description: 0 all messages, 1 only @mentions, 2 nothing. null inherits (the guild level for a channel override, the guild's default_message_notifications for the guild).

DefaultReaction.title: DefaultReaction
DefaultReaction.description: Default reaction emoji of a forum channel.

DeliveryMode.title: DeliveryMode
DeliveryMode.description: Discordy message delivery mode. Strictness: standard (0) < ephemeral (1) < p2p (2).

type.description: EmbedType: rich, link, image, video, gifv or article. Server-generated unfurls use every type but rich.

EmbedMedia.title: EmbedMedia
EmbedMedia.description: Embed image, thumbnail or video. For unfurled links `url` is the original remote address, `proxy_url` a signed media-proxy URL on the CDN host that clients load instead; a video of type text/html is an allow-listed player iframe.

Emoji.title: Emoji
Emoji.description: A custom or unicode emoji. Unicode emojis have a null id.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: REST error envelope with a Discord-style error code (see protocol.json rest.error_codes).

ForumTag.title: ForumTag
ForumTag.description: A tag that can be applied to forum threads.

GuildFolder.title: GuildFolder
GuildFolder.description: One entry of the user's server rail (`user_settings.guild_folders`). The array order is the rail order. An entry with a `null` id is a plain, un-foldered server (exactly one guild id); an entry with an id is a folder.

id.description: Folder id chosen by the client (stable per user); null for a single un-foldered server.

GuildFull.title: GuildFull
GuildFull.description: A guild with its full state (GUILD_CREATE payload and the internal guild state endpoint).

splash.description: Invite splash image hash (CDN path splashes/{guild_id}/{hash}), or null.

owner.description: True if the current user owns the guild.

system_channel_flags.description: Bit set of system message suppressions: 1 join notifications, 2 server boosts, 4 setup tips, 8 join reply buttons, 16 role subscription purchases, 32 their reply buttons. A set bit turns that message off; 0 keeps all on. Join messages are posted to system_channel_id when it is set and bit 1 is clear.

banner.description: Banner image hash (CDN path banners/{guild_id}/{hash}), or null.

voice_region.description: Discordy: voice region ID used to allocate voice nodes.

audit_log_enabled.description: Whether new audit entries are recorded. Audit-policy changes are always recorded. Existing entries remain readable within retention.

audit_log_retention_days.description: Retention for audit entries, including policy changes. Expired entries are excluded immediately and removed by the hourly retention job.

prune_admin_only.description: Discordy: when true, only administrators may prune inactive members.

avatar.description: Server avatar hash; null uses the global avatar. CDN: /guilds/{guild_id}/users/{user_id}/avatars/{hash}.png (animated a_ hashes use .gif).

banner.description: Server banner hash; null uses the global banner. CDN: /guilds/{guild_id}/users/{user_id}/banners/{hash}.png (animated a_ hashes use .gif).

permissions.description: Total permissions in the interaction channel; only in interaction payloads.

bio.description: Server-specific About me; trimmed, null or blank restores the global bio.

GuildNotificationSettings.title: GuildNotificationSettings
GuildNotificationSettings.description: The current user's notification settings for one guild, or for their DMs when guild_id is null (Discord's user guild settings). A channel override beats the guild level, which beats the guild's default_message_notifications. A muted guild mutes all its channels. Private to the user, synced to every session.

guild_id.description: null for direct messages and group DMs.

message_notifications.description: 0 all messages, 1 only @mentions, 2 nothing. null inherits (the guild level for a channel override, the guild's default_message_notifications for the guild).

channel_overrides.description: Only channels with a non-default override.

IdReservation.title: IdReservation
IdReservation.description: Committed exclusive-end millisecond interval for one process. Generation must fail outside this range or after end_ms-issued_at_ms measured monotonically from request START, including network time. Renewal must retain owner, worker and start and never shorten the end. Only a database commit grants a usable interval; failure grants nothing.

IdReservationRequest.title: IdReservationRequest
IdReservationRequest.description: One request per process owner. A fresh process always chooses a fresh UUID; owner IDs must never be shared or restored. The HTTP endpoint accepts service messages only; API uses its database adapter directly. Workers0 and64 remain permanently reserved for legacy issuers.

InternalCreateMessageRequest.title: InternalCreateMessageRequest
InternalCreateMessageRequest.description: POST /internal/v1/channels/{id}/messages on messages. Bot, webhook, interaction and system messages; the user permission check is skipped, non-standard delivery modes still answer 409 (50160). `type` selects a system message: 1 RECIPIENT_ADD and 2 RECIPIENT_REMOVE (target_user_id), 3 CALL (call; author_id is the caller), 4 CHANNEL_NAME_CHANGE (content is the name), 5 CHANNEL_ICON_CHANGE, 6 CHANNEL_PINNED_MESSAGE (message_reference), 7 GUILD_MEMBER_JOIN (author_id is the member who joined; the caller picks the guild system channel), 18 THREAD_CREATED (thread_id, content is the thread name). Pinning through the public API already posts type 6 from messages.

author_id.description: The bot user, the webhook id for webhook posts, or the author of a system message.

tts.description: The calling service enforces SEND_TTS_MESSAGES. Stored for ordinary messages; system messages always have tts false.

flags.description: 64 (ephemeral) sends only to target_user_ids and stores nothing.

type.description: System message type (see description); omit or 0 for a normal message.

target_user_id.description: The user a type 1 or 2 message is about.

thread_id.description: The thread a type 18 message announces (required for type 18).

token.description: The raw Authorization header value or bare token.

mention_here.description: Extension. With mention_everyone: the message pings with @here only (no @everyone), so only members who are online at send time are notified. Absent or false otherwise.

nonce.description: Client nonce used to resolve optimistic sends.

hit.description: Only in message search results: true for the matching message, absent for its context messages.

type.description: MessageType. 0 DEFAULT, 1 RECIPIENT_ADD, 2 RECIPIENT_REMOVE, 3 CALL (see call), 4 CHANNEL_NAME_CHANGE, 5 CHANNEL_ICON_CHANGE, 6 CHANNEL_PINNED_MESSAGE (message_reference is the pinned message), 7 GUILD_MEMBER_JOIN (author is the member who joined; posted in the guild system channel when one is set), 18 THREAD_CREATED (content is the thread name, message_reference.channel_id the thread), 19 REPLY. A forwarded message keeps type 0 and is identified by message_reference.type = 1 plus message_snapshots (Discord semantics).

message_snapshots.description: Present on messages with message_reference.type = 1 (FORWARD): a frozen copy of the forwarded message taken at forward time.

MessageCall.title: MessageCall
MessageCall.description: Payload of a type 3 (CALL) message. ended_timestamp is null while the call is running and is set when it ends.

participants.description: IDs of the users who took part in the call.

MessageComponent.title: MessageComponent
MessageComponent.description: A message component (action row, button, select menu, text input). Action rows nest components.

MessageInteractionMetadata.title: MessageInteractionMetadata
MessageInteractionMetadata.description: The interaction a message responds to.

MessageReference.title: MessageReference
MessageReference.description: Reference to another message (reply, forward, crosspost). type 0 = DEFAULT (reply), 1 = FORWARD. A FORWARD reference requires message_id and channel_id; the server copies the source message into message_snapshots at send time and the reference is informational afterwards (the viewer may lack access to the source channel). On a PIN (type 6) message, message_id is the pinned message. On a THREAD_CREATED (type 18) message, message_id is absent and channel_id is the created thread.

MessageSnapshot.title: MessageSnapshot
MessageSnapshot.description: A frozen copy of a forwarded message. Attachments are re-referenced (same stored object, freshly signed URLs); the snapshot never changes when the source is edited or deleted.

MessagesAdminStats.title: MessagesAdminStats
MessagesAdminStats.description: GET /internal/v1/admin/stats on messages. Counts only, never content.

MuteConfig.title: MuteConfig
MuteConfig.description: When a mute ends. end_time null means until turned off; an end_time in the past means the mute has expired and is ignored.

NotificationRecipient.title: NotificationRecipient
NotificationRecipient.description: A current channel viewer and their resolved notification policy. Independent of push-token ownership; includes desktop-only users. These are policy facts, not an instruction to increment a badge for every message.

online.description: Whether a live gateway session was observed for this page. This is not proof that a mobile app is in the foreground.

level.description: Resolved channel, parent, guild or server-default level: 0 all messages, 1 mentions, 2 nothing.

muted.description: A guild, channel or parent mute is active at evaluated_at. An end_time equal to or before that time is expired.

NotificationRecipientPage.title: NotificationRecipientPage
NotificationRecipientPage.description: A bounded page of currently permitted Standard-channel recipients, excluding author_id. Permissions and preferences are resolved per request, not a historical or cross-page snapshot. A filtered page may be empty with a non-null next_after; continue until null. Private delivery modes return no recipients and no continuation.

next_after.description: Last examined candidate ID when more candidates remain. May refer to an excluded author or hidden member. Pass as after to continue.

PartialUser.title: PartialUser
PartialUser.description: A user reference that only guarantees the ID (presence updates, audit logs).

PermissionBitset.title: PermissionBitset
PermissionBitset.description: A 64-bit permission bitfield serialized as a decimal string. Bit values are listed in permissions.json.

PermissionOverwrite.title: PermissionOverwrite
PermissionOverwrite.description: A channel permission overwrite for a role or member.

Reaction.title: Reaction
Reaction.description: Reactions of one emoji on a message.

ReadState.title: ReadState
ReadState.description: One channel's read snapshot. Version is optional only for legacy servers; a certified response requires it on every entry.

ReadStateVersion.title: ReadStateVersion
ReadStateVersion.description: Per-user/channel authoritative mutation sequence, encoded as a decimal string to avoid JavaScript rounding. Range 0..9223372036854775807; producers fail closed at exhaustion. Compare numerically within a session, never against message IDs or gateway sequence.

SelectOption.title: SelectOption
SelectOption.description: An option of a string select menu.

Snowflake.title: Snowflake
Snowflake.description: A 64-bit Discordy Snowflake ID serialized as a decimal string (42 bits ms since 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, 10 bits worker, 12 bits sequence).

ThreadMember.title: ThreadMember
ThreadMember.description: A user's membership of a thread.

UpdateCallRequest.title: UpdateCallRequest
UpdateCallRequest.description: PATCH /internal/v1/channels/{id}/messages/{id}/call on messages. Records the end of a call on its type 3 message; omitted fields stay unchanged. Answers the updated Message and publishes MESSAGE_UPDATE. 400 when the message is not a call.

User.title: User
User.description: A Discordy user (Discord v10 User object).

bio.description: Profile About me text, at most 300 characters.

email.description: Only returned for the current user.

pronouns.description: Optional public pronouns; trimmed, null or blank clears them. At most 40 Unicode characters.

theme_colors.description: Exactly two RGB colors (0..16777215) for the profile theme. Null resets to the default theme.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Client preferences that follow the account across devices (client#123). Sparse: a key is present only once the user (or a first-run migration) set it; clients fall back to their defaults for missing keys. As a PATCH value the object is merged key by key. Device-specific settings (audio and video devices, volumes, keybinds, window state, desktop notification toggle, taskbar flash) are not stored here.

hide_age_restricted_channels.description: Hide age-restricted channels and block their content in clients. Missing means false: channels remain visible but require explicit confirmation per channel and session before content loads. This is a content preference, not verified age or server authorization.

link_previews.description: Show previews (embeds) of links in messages.

saturation.description: Colour saturation of the interface, 1 is full colour (accessibility).

role_colors.description: How role colours show on member names: tint the name, a dot beside it, or not at all.

message_spacing.description: Space in pixels between message groups.

high_contrast.description: Increase contrast of text and borders.

animate_gifs.description: Play GIFs automatically; when off they play on hover.

tts_read_aloud.description: Allow the /tts command and read text-to-speech messages aloud.

tts_rate.description: Speech rate of text-to-speech playback, 1 is normal.

sound_toggles.description: Per-sound switches under notify_sounds; a missing entry means on.

skin_tone.description: Skin tone modifier of the emoji picker; empty for the default.

recent_reactions.description: Recently used reaction emoji, most recent first.

UserReadStates.title: UserReadStates
UserReadStates.description: Messages-owned read-state snapshots. Header X-Read-State-Versioned: 1 certifies that every entry is versioned and the writer publishes authoritative updates, including for an empty array. Gateway must reject malformed certified entries and duplicate channel IDs.

UserReadyState.title: UserReadyState
UserReadyState.description: GET /internal/v1/users/{user_id}/ready: the state used to build READY.

user_guild_settings.description: Stored notification settings of the user's guilds and DMs (guild_id null); guilds without a row use the defaults.

notes.description: The user's private notes keyed by the noted user's id.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Account-wide settings of the current user. `default_delivery_mode` is a Discordy extra.

default_delivery_mode.description: Default delivery mode for DMs and group DMs without a per-chat override.

e2ee_calls_default.description: When true, every call the user starts or joins is end-to-end encrypted (DMs, group DMs, voice channels, Go Live). A call is E2EE for everyone when any participant has this set.

guild_folders.description: The user's server rail in order, with folders. Synced across devices.

pinned_dm_channel_ids.description: DM and group DM channels pinned to the top of the DM list (at most 5), most recently pinned last. Synced across devices.

pinned_channel_ids.description: Personal pinned channels per server, at most 10 per server (guild id to channel ids, most recently pinned last), shown at the top of that server's channel list. Visible only to the user. Synced across devices.

guild_positions.description: Flat server order (legacy mirror of guild_folders).

preferences.description: Synced client preferences (appearance, chat, notification sounds, emoji). Sparse.
